mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, name AS name, subject AS subject, body AS body, status AS status, send_mode AS mode, template_group AS "group", TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM email_templates WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY template_group, name

SELECT id, name, subject, body, status, send_mode AS mode, template_group AS "group", TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM email_templates WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_templates (id, name, subject, body, status, send_mode, template_group, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{status}, #{sendMode}, #{templateGroup}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_templates SET name = #{name}, subject = #{subject}, body = #{body}, status = #{status}, send_mode = #{sendMode}, template_group = #{templateGroup}, updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
